These dictionary files and LICENSE are from OpenCC 1.1.9 (Apache-2.0):

- https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC/tree/ver.1.1.9/data/dictionary
- https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC/blob/ver.1.1.9/LICENSE

Used only during city-name maintenance to normalize Chinese labels to simplified
characters. No transliteration or translation is performed. The website has no
OpenCC dependency. A small longest-match dictionary reader handles TSPhrases
first and then TSCharacters; it is not a complete OpenCC engine.
